title: Inspect and extend: From typed text to a post
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/feed.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve composer validation, length limits, and immutable insertion.
problem: A composer is a small form with a gatekeeper. Trace the text field to canPublish and publishPost, note trimming and the 300-character rule, and follow how the new record is placed at the top without mutating the previous list. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/feed.ts` and the related project files: src/screens/FeedScreen.tsx; src/feed.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to composer validation, length limits, and immutable insertion.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Publishing stores a local post; there is no authenticated AT Protocol write.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A composer is a small form with a gatekeeper. Trace the text field to canPublish and publishPost, note trimming and the 300-character rule, and follow how the new record is placed at the top without mutating the previous list.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/feed.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
